purpose.en: Train the outer hip with a controlled standing side leg raise while keeping the trunk steady.

text.zh: 身体站直，右腿向侧面抬起再慢慢放下，脚尖朝前
text.en: Stand tall, raise your right leg to the side, and lower it slowly with your toes facing forwards

text.zh: 左脚踩稳，骨盆尽量保持水平，双手轻放髋侧
text.en: Keep the left foot planted and pelvis level, with the hands resting lightly on the hips.

text.zh: 向侧面抬右腿，不把脚尖转向外或把身体倒向另一侧
text.en: Lift the right leg sideways without turning the toes out or leaning the trunk away.

text.zh: 缓慢放下到脚悬在身旁，完成当前侧剂量后再换边
text.en: Lower slowly until the foot hovers beside you and complete this side dose before changing sides.

commonErrors.zh: 身体向左倒、耸髋，靠甩腿增加高度
commonErrors.en: Leaning left, hiking the pelvis or swinging the leg to gain height.

commonErrors.zh: 脚尖外转，膝盖明显弯曲或回落时踩地借力
commonErrors.en: Turning the toes out, bending the knee excessively or pushing off the ground between raises.

items.zh: 支撑膝踝与平衡：左足踩稳，左膝保持自然，不靠扭脚或锁膝稳定。
items.en: Supporting knee, ankle and balance: keep the left foot stable and knee natural rather than twisting the foot or forcing the knee locked.

items.zh: 髋与腰侧：只抬到骨盆和躯干仍能保持稳定的高度，不耸髋。
items.en: Hip and side of the waist: raise the leg only as high as you can keep the pelvis and trunk steady without hiking the hip.

items.zh: 本动作引发疼痛时停止，不通过增加幅度或负重继续；先向医生或物理治疗师确认。
items.en: Stop if this exercise causes pain; do not add range or load before seeking clinical advice.

items.zh: 已有医嘱限制单腿负重、站立平衡或髋外展时，先取得许可。
items.en: Obtain clearance first if single-leg loading, standing balance or hip abduction has been restricted.

definition.countingSemantics: One right-leg raise and controlled lowering counts as one rep. The 8-second clip contains two right-leg reps with left-foot support and no side change. Keep default reps=12; proposed interpretation is 12 per working side (six loops), but legacy metadata does not explicitly state per-side versus total and editorial confirmation is required. Do not switch sides automatically every loop or generate mirrored media.
definition.movementSides: Right leg abducts while the left leg supports throughout. Eight seconds is an optional external boundary after the prescribed per-side dose, not a switch encoded in the clip.
editorialNotes: startingSide=right指抬起/主要外展训练腿，left为支撑腿。8秒源右腿2次，无片内换边，不生成镜像。
旧catalog默认12但没有明确perSide处方文本，本稿提出每侧12次（右侧6loops），数值不变；总计/每侧解释仍须编辑确认，不因unilateral=true自动翻倍。
同ID可缩小外展幅度作为调整。未验证同模式替代/独立扶物降阶/进阶的稳定ID，关系留空而不把无关内收肌动作充数；源不含扶椅，不新增椅子或改锚点。
相位来自catalog/v2/batches/b002.json真实源时间；剂量数字与范围保持旧catalog。rhythm只描述动画，不使用旧reps或holdSeconds来覆盖处方。
具体双语注意、通用禁用筛查、协同肌群与关系均为待审草稿；协同包含稳定/次要拉伸角色，不是额外高亮或肌电激活结论。
关系均为本仓库真实ID候选，不等于已有同模型可发布v2包；不得自动回退弃用模型素材。空关系缺口见逐动作说明。
通用医学筛查证据边界沿用catalog/v2/definition-evidence.md的AAOS/NHS一手资料；不编造疾病特异绝对禁忌，编辑/医学审核均保持pending。
